name: Medium Armor Master
description: Prerequisite: Level 4+, Medium Armor Training You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Dexterous Wearer
features.description: While you're wearing Medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity score of 16 or higher.
